name: decant
description: Decant — pour off what several coding-agent harnesses do well, leave the sediment: risk-aware routing, an invocation ceiling, inspectable file evidence, hash-frozen replay, and a pluggable model backend.

scripts.check: npm run test && npm run lint && npm run validate:skills
scripts.lint: node --check src/*.mjs && node --check src/providers/*.mjs && node --check test/*.mjs && node --check scripts/*.mjs
scripts.smoke: node src/cli.mjs doctor && node src/cli.mjs route "research and build a small CLI" --json
